basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old mechanical engineer from Maryland with a keen interest in firearms and fantasy literature. I spend my weekends at the local shooting range and my evenings diving into the Shadow and Bone series. Currently, I'm exploring language learning apps like Earthlingo and occasionally dip into job search tips as I consider a career shift. I’m single, enjoy late-night gaming sessions, and am often online after 10 PM. I dislike overly complex manuals, as you might have guessed!

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid foundation in mechanical engineering, having graduated from a reputable state university. My knowledge of firearms is largely self-taught through hands-on experience and active participation in relevant subreddits. I also have a casual interest in fantasy genre books and shows, which I explore in my downtime.
